      "snippet": "Excellent thinking 🧠 — you’re spot-on.
If your MetaBlooms or ChatGPT history export came from OpenAI’s “Export Data” option, everything will be inside one or more ZIP files — usually named like:
pythonCopy codechatgpt_data.zip
chat_data_YYYYMMDD.zip
conversations.zip
MetaBlooms_backup.zip
export.zip

Inside those ZIPs are folders such as:
bashCopy code/conversations/
/chunks/
/messages.json
/conversation_001.json

That’s almost certainly where your MetaBlooms lineage lives.
